title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: premium charge and premium remittance rules
content:
## Scope

This policy of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line governs the premium or ad valorem charge on a bound cover and the remittances applied against it. The premium account of a cover records premium charged in, and premium paid or refunded out.

## Policy clause

1. The premium of a bound cover is charged once, at binding.
2. The premium is the insured value multiplied by the product's premium rate percent, increased by the uplift for the cover's cargo category (the dangerous goods uplift for dangerous goods, the reefer uplift for reefer, the out-of-gauge uplift for out-of-gauge cargo, and none for general cargo), then reduced by the contract premium discount when the cover holder holds an active service contract whose tier rank is at least the product's lowest qualifying rank and that rank is not 0.
3. The figure so obtained is raised to the higher of the minimum premium per container multiplied by the cover's container count, and the minimum premium per cover; it is then rounded to the cent.
4. AHL Standard Carrier Liability carries no premium.
5. A premium may be booked only on a cover whose status is active.
6. A cover is charged premium once; the check is whether a premium charge entry already exists on the cover.
7. When prepayment does not apply, the premium is payable within the product's premium due days of binding.
8. A premium remittance is written with the reference exactly as the customer quotes it, may not exceed the unpaid premium on the cover, and a reference is recorded once per cover.

## Remittance checklist

| Check | Passes when |
|---|---|
| Reference | Written character for character as quoted |
| Amount | Not above the unpaid premium on the cover |
| Duplicate reference | No payment entry on the same cover already carries that reference |

## Hypothetical worked example: the minimum premium

Hypothetical figures only: a two-container cover whose rate, uplift and discount produce 41.30 USD, under a product whose minimum per container is 30.00 USD and minimum per cover is 55.00 USD. The higher minimum is 30.00 multiplied by 2, which is 60.00, against 55.00; the premium is raised to 60.00 USD.

## Points of judgement

**May premium be charged on a cover still in the quoted state?** No. A premium may be booked only on an active cover.

**The customer remits the same reference twice on one cover. Is the second remittance recorded?** No. A reference is recorded once per cover.
